title: Vision English OCR reliability
goal: Measure exact English OCR against a deterministic invoice fixture.
prompt: Use vision.analyze with mode ocr, detail high, and output detailed. Transcribe the image exactly and do not infer missing text.
prerequisites: Configure a vision-capable route and explicit provider credentials.
Review hosted image processing, budget, and approval settings before enabling this opt-in task.
steps: Run the prompt against the fixture through a trusted disposable workspace.
Compare the response with the expected strings in manifest.json.
Record tool metadata and metric values in the generated results.json.
assertions: All four expected lines are present with exact identifiers and amount.
No text absent from the image is presented as observed.
The response includes route, latency, usage, normalization, and fallback metadata.
notes: Accuracy percent is exact expected strings recovered divided by four.
A current-turn explicit fixture should not create repeated approval prompts after the required policy decision.
